in_marathi.name: Digamber
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sky-clad, wearing white
in_marathi.long_meaning: Digamber हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Digambara refers to a Jain monk who wears white clothes, symbolizing purity and renunciation. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dig' (sky or universe) and 'ambar' (clad or dressed). In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is also sometimes referred to as Digambar, meaning the one who wears the universe.
